creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Commit 75b5f33 ("remove confirmation prompts from delete commands")
removed the `--force`/`-f` flag and confirmation prompts from `kan
delete`, `kan board delete`, and `kan column delete`, since Kan is
git-backed and deletes are recoverable. That commit updated the
published CLI docs (cli.md) but missed the Claude skill doc, which
still documents the flag and the old confirmation behavior.

The skill is the contract agents follow, so the stale flag actively
misleads them. Concretely: following the skill, an agent ran
`kan delete <card> --force` and hit `unknown flag: --force`, then had
to discover the real behavior by reading source.

Stale references in extras/skill/SKILL.md:
  - L388: `kan delete 12` comment claims "prompts for confirmation"
  - L390: `kan delete 12 --force` example
  - L397: `-f, --force | Skip confirmation ...` row in the flags table
  - L404: `kan board delete` comment claims "prompts for confirmation"
  - L405: `kan board delete features -f` example

Fix: bring the skill's delete / board-delete / column-delete docs in
line with cli.md (no `--force`, no confirmation prompt). Worth a quick
grep of SKILL.md for any other drift from the same commit.
title: Skill doc references removed 'kan delete --force' flag
